artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.artist: Master of the Dutuit Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image captures two figures - a seated woman holding a child on her lap. The woman has long hair, a halo, and is dressed in a flowing robe. The child, also with a halo, gestures upward with one arm and extends the other arm towards the woman. Both figures have simple, stylized features. They are seated on a bench with a plain wall in the background.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Master of the Dutuit Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in full length. In the center, a person on a wooden crucifix with nails in their hands and feet, and a crown of thorns on their head. They have long hair and a beard, and wear a white cloth around the waist. On the left, a figure in a blue cloak, white headscarf, and fair complexion, clasping their hands together. On the right, a figure in a red robe holding a book or scroll with their right hand. Both side figures have halos. The background has a simple border with floral designs in the corners, against a parchment-colored backdrop.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.artist: Master of the Dutuit Mount of Olives after Master of St. Erasmus
artworks.dimensions:
image (printed borderlines): 6 × 4.1 cm (2 3/8 × 1 5/8 in.)
sheet: 7.3 × 6.5 cm (2 7/8 × 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. This individual is shown from head to toe, with their body slightly turned to the side and their head tilted. They have a peaceful expression, with smooth facial features and chin-length, wavy hair. The person is wearing a blue robe with a red cloak on their shoulders, and there is a golden halo around their head. They are holding a golden chalice in their left hand, from which a small dragon or snake is emerging. The background has a floral pattern in green on a beige backdrop, with a red border. The surrounding card or paper is decorated with stylized tendrils and leaves in blue and black along the edges.

artworks.title: Faun Battling a Snake
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure in a dynamic position. He is leaning forward with his right arm raised and left arm extended downwards, gripping a serpent that coils around his arm. The face is drawn in profile with short, straight hair. The figure is nude, displaying muscular definition, with drapery billowing around his shoulders and back. An inscription is included on the right side. The background has diagonal lines and the ground has etched foliage.

artworks.title: Mutius Scaevola
artworks.description: This is a drawing of armored figures around a table. The group appears to be engaged in a discussion or transaction. In the center, a sword is held prominently. The setting includes a tent with drapery and a table with patterned fabric. Various symbols of warfare, such as spears and armor, are present. The use of line work and cross-hatching enhances the dimensionality and texture of the drawing.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays a design of large leaves and flowers at the center, with a small figure holding a blooming plant. The color palette is black and white, with shading for depth and texture. A cherubic figure is seen at the bottom surrounded by swirling leaves, with stems and leaves reaching upward. The initials "F.G." are visible near the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Children Harvesting Grapes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures engaged in activities with baskets of fruit and a goat. The figures are depicted in a dynamic composition, interacting with each other in a playful and idyllic atmosphere. The details in the drawing add depth and texture to the piece.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Bacchus
artworks.description: This image shows a mythological procession with a chariot, horses, and various figures. The drawing features a highly detailed scene with a decorative chariot pulled by two horses. A figure resembling a god or mythical leader sits in the chariot holding a staff. Surrounding the chariot are various figures, some with animalistic features like horns and goat-like legs, appearing to be fauns or satyrs. The figures are engaged in a celebratory procession, carrying vessels, platters, and garlands. The shading and composition of the drawing create a sense of depth and activity, capturing the grand and mythical nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Christ Stripped
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a scene where a person is being dressed or undressed by others. The central figure has wounds or markings on their body and a halo around their head. Two figures are holding the central figure's garment, while the other two figures are in animated postures. The colors used are vivid, including reds, blues, greens, and yellows. The scene is set against a landscape with rolling hills or mounds. The style is reminiscent of medieval woodblock prints or early religious iconography.

artworks.title: Sheath with Warrior
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing confidently in a strong pose. He has a beard and a determined expression, wearing a detailed helmet with a plume, segmented armor resembling feathers, a cloak draped behind him, and armored greaves on his lower legs. He appears to be holding a sword and is barefoot. The background features cross-hatching texture and ornate embellishments with numerals at the bottom.

artworks.title: Ornament with Fantastic Satyr and Dolphins
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design with a mythical figure and decorative acanthus pattern. The central figure is a bearded man with curly hair emerging from intertwined scrolls and leaves. The figure's arms are extended outward, harmonizing with the artwork's curves. Two serpentine creatures or fish-like forms flank the central figure, contributing to the symmetry. The design is detailed with shading and line work for texture.

artworks.title: Bagpipe Player with His Lover
artworks.description: This is an image of a seated meeting in a natural setting. Two figures are seated under a tree, talking. One figure holds a musical instrument resembling a bagpipe, and the other holds a large sack or pitcher. The scene is set against foliage and grass, hinting at an outdoor location. The lines and shading show texture in the clothing and facial features. The style is detailed and traditional.

artworks.title: Emblem with Hope, Tribulation, Envy, and Tolerance
artworks.description: The image features personifications of virtues and decorative elements. Three allegorical figures are positioned around an altar, surrounded by a circular frame. The figures are engaged in a ritualistic act, with one holding tongs and another reaching towards a cloud above. The frame is adorned with Latin inscriptions and elaborate scrollwork. Cherubic figures with garlands and musical instruments flank the base. The scene is set against a pillar topped with a vase of flowers.

artworks.title: Temperantia (Temperance)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure pouring liquid from one dish into another. The composition shows a nude figure with long, flowing hair, seated on a decorative structure resembling a stylized bench. The figure holds a dish in each hand, with liquid flowing from the upper dish into the lower one. To the left of the figure, there is an architectural arch framing a distant landscape with a small village or cluster of buildings. The word "TEMPERANTIA" is inscribed in the upper left. The drawing features intricate line work, particularly in the depiction of the figure's hair and the textures of the surfaces.

artworks.title: Iusticia (Justice)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in profile, sitting on a stone-like structure with her legs bent. She has a braided updo and is nude, holding a sword in her left hand and balancing scales with her right hand. In the background, there are curtains and a rural scene with a church steeple and trees visible through an opening.

artworks.title: Spes (Hope)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a stone structure, hands clasped together in front of them. They have wavy hair, are partly draped in fabric, and are looking to the side. An intricate urn is placed to the left. In the background on the right, buildings are visible under a sky with rays, and the word "SPES" is inscribed in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Fortitudo
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a seated lion, with her left arm resting on the lion's mane and her right arm holding an ornate architectural detail. She has braided hair and a calm expression, looking to the side. The background features large stone structures and a distant fortified tower or castle, amidst trees and sky.

artworks.title: Sol (The Sun)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seen from behind, standing upright. The person has a muscular build, a full beard, curly hair, and wears an elaborate sun-themed headpiece. They are dressed in a draped garment, holding a staff and resting their other hand on an oval shield with a lion's face. The background includes lined details, a tree, and foliage. There is text "SOL" at the top right corner and an inscribed box with numbers at the top left.

artworks.title: Marcus Curtius
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a figure on horseback with a muscular build and nude torso, viewed from behind. The horse is detailed with textures in its mane, tail, and body. The figure appears to hold a shield and possibly a weapon. The background features etched lines, creating depth and environment, possibly suggesting movement across a landscape. The composition is circular, focusing on the central figures and their energy.

artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 x 7 cm (3 7/16 x 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person's body, focusing on their face and shoulders. The individual faces forward with a slight turn to their right. They have distinct facial features, including prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a slightly furrowed brow. The person's hair is short and curly, peeking out from under a large beret-style hat. They are wearing a collared garment with vertical lines, and a notable button or clasp on the right shoulder. In front of them is a banner or scroll with an inscription "IN SILENCIO ET SPE ERIT FORTITVDO VESTRA M L." The background has a simple, densely lined texture. In the top right corner, there are initials and a date "15 IB 30."

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.description: The image shows a knight fighting a dragon in a medieval setting. The knight is on horseback, wearing armor and wielding a sword, engaging with the dragon. In the scene, there is a castle on a hill, partially obscured by trees. A figure in a gown is watching the battle from a distance. The background features hills, architecture, and a forested area.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclined slightly forward on the back of a bull. She grasps the bull's neck, with a calm expression on her face. Her hair flows around her shoulders, and she wears a draped garment. The bull is in motion, seemingly moving through water. The background includes mountains, a river, trees, and a village or castle on a hill. Wispy clouds fill the sky.

artworks.title: Triumphal Procession of Bacchus
artworks.medium: engraving and punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (circle, trimmed within platemark): 12.8 × 13 cm (5 1/16 × 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular ornamental scene featuring various mythical creatures or figures in an intricate design. The circle is filled with detailed figures that appear to be engaging in activities or celebrations, surrounded by a landscape filled with foliage, buildings, and animals such as boars. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, showcasing muscular detail and movement. The outer ring design juxtaposes a natural environment with active figures, highlighting the interplay between nature and mythology. The central section of the disk is empty, focusing on the detailed scene along the outer circular band with precise linework consistent with classical ornamental art.

artworks.title: Bacchus Seated on a Barrel and Holding Grapes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (circle, trimmed within platemark): 12.1 × 12 cm (4 3/4 × 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy skyline with hills and clusters of buildings. A figure sits atop a barrel marked "1582" next to a smaller figure sitting in a basket surrounded by grapes. A pond or river with swans is also included in the scene. The style appears to be a woodcut or engraving, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white emphasizing detailed line work.
